name: Harlem Blade II ~Dark Angel~
original_name: ハーレムブレイドII～Dark Angel～
source:
Our guy left his childhood girl and went to war against a monster after his father got killed in it. When he came back a year later, he was just in time to see his childhood girl taken away by the monster's army. He joined the resistance and started to find her. Within 30 days, he can help girls who will join him in the fight. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
父亲在与怪物的战斗中丧命后，主人公告别青梅竹马，投身对抗怪物的战争。一年后归来时，他正好目睹青梅被怪物军团掳走。他加入抵抗军，开始寻找她。在三十天内，他可以帮助日后会与自己并肩作战的女孩们。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
